abilities.name: Fortifying Brew
abilities.text: Chen drinks from his keg, gaining 50 Brew and 190 temporary Shields per second, up to a maximum of 570 while drinking. Shields persist for 4 seconds after he stops drinking.

abilities.name: Flying Kick
abilities.text: Kick through target enemy, dealing 130 damage.

abilities.name: Keg Smash
abilities.text:
Deal 50 damage and soak enemies in Brew for 3 seconds, Slowing them by 10%. After 1.25 seconds, the Slow is increased to 40%.

After being used, this Ability becomes Breath of Fire.

Breath of Fire
Deal damage and Ignite Brew-soaked enemies.

abilities.name: Stagger
abilities.text: Damage taken over the next 3 seconds is prevented. Once this effect ends, Chen receives 75% of the damage taken over 5 seconds. This damage cannot be modified.

abilities.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
abilities.text:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability. The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield.
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies.
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

abilities.name: Wandering Keg
abilities.text: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

1.name: Accumulating Flame
1.text:
Reward: Damage enemy Heroes with Breath of Fire to permanently increase periodic damage by 0.25. Kills grant 2.

Reward: After gaining 25 damage, increase the range of Keg Smash.

Mythic Reward: Upon gaining 80 damage, Breath of Fire reduces enemy Armor by 20 and its duration is increased by 0.75 seconds each time Chen attacks the Hero.

1.name: Freshest Ingredients
1.text:
Increase the healing duration of Regeneration Globes by 150%.

Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.

Reward: Reduce Fortifying Brew's cooldown by 2 seconds, and 50% of its Shield persists indefinitely after drinking.

1.name: Stormstout Secret Recipe
1.text: Chen heals for 3.5% of his maximum Health when his Basic Abilities hit an enemy Hero.

4.name: Deadly Strike
4.text: Flying Kick no longer costs Brew. Additionally, its damage is increased by 125% while Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

4.name: Eye of the Tiger
4.text: Basic Attacks against Brew-soaked enemy Heroes deal 50% more damage and heal Chen for 60% of the damage done.

4.name: Withering Flames
4.text: Igniting an enemy Hero reduces their Spell Power by 60% for 4 seconds.

7.name: Gift of the Ox
7.text: Increase the duration of Stagger's damage prevention by 2 seconds, and reduce the amount of damage taken over time to 50% of damage taken.

7.name: Brewmaster's Balance
7.text: While at or below 50 Brew, gain 20% Movement Speed. While at or above 50 Brew, regenerate an additional 18 Health per second.

7.name: Elusive Brawler
7.text: Activate to gain 20% Movement Speed and Evade enemy Basic Attacks for 2 seconds. Chen's Basic Attacks reduce this cooldown by 2 seconds.

10.name: Wandering Keg
10.text: Roll around inside an Unstoppable barrel with 70% increased Movement Speed and 25 Armor, dealing 59 damage to enemies in the way and knocking them back. Lasts for 5 seconds.

10.name: Storm, Earth, Fire
10.text:
After 1 second, Chen splits into three elemental spirits for 12 seconds, each with 70% of Chen's maximum Health and a unique Ability. The last spirit Ability that is cast is empowered. If all three spirits are killed, Chen will die as well.

Storm can grant the spirits a Shield.
Earth can leap to an area and Slow enemies.
Fire can grant the spirits Attack Speed, damage.

13.name: Pressure Point
13.text: Flying Kick Slows the target enemy by 40% for 1.5 seconds, or by 80% if Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew.

13.name: A Touch of Honey
13.text: Increase the Slows from Keg Smash by 20% and its duration by 0.5 seconds.

13.name: Ring of Fire
13.text: After Igniting an enemy, become bathed in a fiery aura, dealing 60 damage every second to nearby enemies for 6 seconds.

13.name: Enough to Share
13.text: Fortifying Brew instantly grants Chen a Shield that absorbs 190 damage, and each second grants nearby allied Heroes a Shield that absorbs 140 damage, up to 420.

16.name: Flying Leap
16.text: Increase Flying Kick's range by 15% and reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds each time an enemy Hero takes damage from being Ignited.

16.name: Celerity
16.text: Basic Attacks against Stunned, Rooted, or Slowed enemy Heroes reduce the cooldown of Stagger by 2 seconds and grant Chen 30 Armor for 3 seconds.

16.name: Combo Strikes
16.text: Every 3rd Basic Attack against the same target deals 75% bonus damage. While Chen has Shields from Fortifying Brew and for 2 seconds after, he gains 35% Attack Speed.

20.name: Untapped Potential
20.text: Increase Wandering Keg's Movement Speed bonus from 70% to 125%, and its Armor bonus to 75 for its duration and 5 seconds afterwards.

20.name: Elemental Conduit
20.text: Increase the spirits' Health to 100% of Chen's maximum Health and all of their Abilities are empowered.

20.name: Purifying Brew
20.text: Casting Fortifying Brew grants Chen Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds.

20.name: Energizing Brew
20.text: If Chen Channels Fortifying Brew for its full duration, then he gains 20% bonus Health and 20% bonus damage for 25 seconds.
